subject: 英语
topic: Unit 1 How can I get there
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】science museum 科学博物馆; post office 邮局; bookstore 书店; cinema 电影院; hospital 医院; crossing 十字路口; turn left/right 左转/右转; straight 笔直地; GPS 全球定位系统
【重点句型】Where is ...? ……在哪里？ How can I get to ...? 我怎么到……？ Turn left/right. 左转/右转。 Go straight. 直走。 It's near/next to ... 它在……附近/旁边。
【A Let's talk】Wu Yifan: Robin, where is the museum shop? Robin: It's near the door. Wu Yifan: How can I get to the bookstore? Robin: Turn left at the cinema, then go straight.
【Read and write】I want to go to the science museum. It is next to the post office. Go straight and turn right at the crossing. The museum is on the left. The hospital is behind the cinema. I can use GPS to find the way.
key_points: How can I get to ...? 我怎么到……？
It's near/next to ... 它在……附近/旁边。
